_scoring_comment: DPT is defence points: an extra award on every point (G+A) a defenceman
scores, on top of the goal and assist values -- the rule Dom's sheet
applies as PTS x value on defencemen only. It is a scoring modifier, not
a stat, so it is deliberately absent from sources.json 'stats'.
GS is goalie starts: points per game a goalie starts, which is the board's
GP for goalies. Also positional, also absent from 'stats'. Negative values
are meaningful -- some leagues charge per start.
Every key in 'scoring' becomes an input in the settings panel, so notes
belong out here rather than inside it.

_age_bands_comment: Pre-prime and post-prime markers on the Age column. Ages come from
config/ages.csv where it has the player; these thresholds were
calibrated against that list's reference date (age at season start).

_comment: Manual +/- adjustments, matching the Yahoo sheet's Boost or Bust column.
tiers are the percentages for +/++/+++ (and their negatives).
Only the stats listed here move. That is deliberate: a subjective boost is
an opinion about a player's SCORING, and hits, blocks, PIM and faceoffs are
role and style stats that do not rise when a player finishes better.
SV% and GAA are excluded even though Yahoo lists them -- multiplying a save
percentage by 1.2 would push it past 1.000.
